parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  username: 'QA Incident Alert',
  text: '<!here> [CRITICAL: REGRESSION DETECTED] Automated Test Failure\n' +
    '==================================================\n' +
    '• Status: FAILED\n' +
    '• Failed Tests: ' + $json.totalFailed + '\n' +
    '• Passed Tests: ' + $json.totalPassed + '\n' +
    '• Duration: ' + $json.durationSeconds + 's\n\n' +
    'DIAGNOSTIC ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS:\n' +
    '--------------------------------------------------\n' +
    ($json.diagnosedIssues || []).map((d, i) => 
      '[' + (i+1) + '] Scenario: ' + d.title + '\n' +
      '    Category: ' + d.category + '\n' +
      '    Diagnosis: ' + d.rootCause + '\n' +
      '    Suggested Action: ' + d.suggestion + '\n'
    ).join('\n')
}) }}
